data.narrative:
Chai Discovery is a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Joshua Meier (former Chief AI Officer at Absci and Meta researcher in protein language modeling) and Jack Dent (ex-Stripe). The company's current post-money valuation stands at $3.8B following $400M in total capital raised. Valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), New Limit ($3.1B Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M Series B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.7x Series C-to-next-stage step-up multiplier to the $3.8B base, implying $6.5B. Peer-median anchoring across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields $3.1B, with a range spanning $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp P/S anchoring (median 5.5x across sector tickers) cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue.

The triangulated valuation range is $2.6B (low) to $7.4B (high), with a median of $4.8B. This 2.8x spread reflects meaningful dispersion: the peer-median method anchors conservatively near current valuation, while stage-progression implies material upside. Key uncertainties include the lack of revenue data precluding public-comp validation, the small private-peer sample, and wide valuation dispersion within the biotech cohort ($539M–$10.3B).
